snippet.title: Baptiste - Gameplay Trailer | Coming Soon to Steam, PS5, Xbox & Switch 2
snippet.description:
Baptiste is a new indie horror game coming soon to Steam, PS5, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2. Watch the official gameplay trailer now! 

Developed by Firenut Games, Baptiste is a psychological horror experience built around a haunted doll, twisted puzzles, and a house full of dark family secrets. Explore unsettling environments, solve chilling puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the doll everyone's too afraid to touch. Wishlist Baptiste today and follow Firenut Games for more updates on this upcoming horror game.

🎮 Wishlist now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922250/Baptiste
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP6974-PPSA34892_00-0205334311447322
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/baptiste/9p5v6jd1g30q
Nintendo Switch 2: Coming soon

🕯️ Genre: Psychological Horror / Puzzle Horror
👁️ Developer: Firenut Games
